name: realtor-riverside-editor
displayName: The AI Editing Studio - Riverside engine (Plugin 10)
description: The AI Editing Studio: a full-time video editor inside the agent's Claude. 28 skills across five stages: DIRECT (creative direction, record coach, transcript read, section map), CUT (remove the fluff, hook finder, rescue cut, interview edit), POLISH (audio enhance, color and look, captions, music, B-roll, B-roll library, brand graphics, energy), REPURPOSE (short-form repurpose, weekly batch, podcast, trailer), SHIP (quality check, review and revise, publish), plus setup, a plain-English navigator that also resumes any stopped edit, and three full recipes (long-form, reel, listing). Claude edits directly in the agent's own Riverside account with precise, verifiable operations: no per-edit AI credits, every change proven by a revision diff, every visual checked on real frames, and publishing to YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X only on an explicit yes. One owner per output: it edits video and never writes titles, descriptions, chapters, captions, or designs; those come from the YouTube System, the Short-Form System, and Claude Design. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) and a Riverside Grow plan or higher.
